items.name: GAN New Zealand Nationals 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkyMjg5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c7eabb6e9848f73af3c2df109b13a452d579e9a2/Nats_26.webp) GAN New Zealand Nationals 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. ​ This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. ​ Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. ​ [Website](https://speedcubing.org.nz) | [Facebook](https://facebook.com/speedcubingnz) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/speedcubingnewzealand)
